description: This file defines the final class `AudioInputDeviceObserver` which manages listening to changes in the system's audio input devices, including default input device selection, device list updates, and device existence checks. It provides static methods to query current device states and instance methods to start/stop observing device changes, logging events accordingly.

classes.name: AudioInputDeviceObserver
classes.description: Manages observing audio input device changes and provides utility methods to query device states.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceUID
methods.description: Returns the UID of the system's default input device if available.

methods.name: aliveInputDeviceUIDs
methods.description: Returns a set of UIDs for all alive input devices.

methods.name: hasUsableDefaultInputDevice
methods.description: Checks if the default input device exists, is alive, and has input channels.

methods.name: defaultInputDeviceSummary
methods.description: Provides a string summary of the default input device, including its name and UID.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins observing audio device changes, executing a callback on changes.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops observing device changes and removes listeners.
